essence: Outer and inner dimensions are to be determined by taking the central petal and its middle measure as the reference.
One should extend both half the petal-root strength and the root support.
At the front, using the petal width, one should measure half of it from the foot.
One should arrange the middle at the petal tip in that way, or alternatively arrange the remainder.
The petal width may be divided into four, five, six, seven, or eight parts.
